description: Defines input location classes, validation constraints, and validators for different location types in an event management context, including address, link, integration, phone, attendee, and organizer default app locations.

classes.name: InputAddressLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents an address location input with validation for address string and type.

classes.name: InputOrganizersDefaultApp_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a default organizer app location input with type validation.

classes.name: InputLinkLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a link location input with URL validation.

classes.name: InputIntegrationLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents an integration location input with supported integration type validation.

classes.name: InputPhoneLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a phone location input with phone number validation.

classes.name: InputAttendeeAddressLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents an attendee address location input with type validation.

classes.name: InputAttendeePhoneLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents an attendee phone location input with type validation.

classes.name: InputAttendeeDefinedLocation_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents an attendee defined location input with type validation.

classes.name: InputLocationValidator_2024_06_14
classes.description: Asynchronous validator class for validating arrays of location objects based on their type.

classes.name: InputTeamLocationValidator_2024_06_14
classes.description: Asynchronous validator class for validating team location arrays, including default app type.

methods.name: ValidateLocations_2024_06_14
methods.description: Decorator factory for registering location validation on properties.

methods.name: ValidateTeamLocations_2024_06_14
methods.description: Decorator factory for registering team location validation on properties.
